asset_sweating.name: Asset Sweating
asset_sweating.description: Maximize equipment utilization and defer replacements. Accepts higher maintenance risk for greater runtime.

comfort_first.name: Comfort First
comfort_first.description: Prioritize occupant comfort with tight temperature bands and fast fault response. Accepts higher costs.

cost_saving.name: Cost Saving
cost_saving.description: Minimize operational spend. Favor load shifting, reduced runtime, and energy optimization.
